translations.text: It is also because of you, O leader of evil, that every scheme of wickedness came into being.
For if you had not placed every evil ahead of every good, working within people—
hatred against love, hostility against peace, defilement against purity, violence against righteousness and justice, and every other kind of ungodliness against godliness—
this whole multitude would not have gone to destruction.
Blessed are those who understand what a mass of grass and straw amounts to before the fire that will be thrown upon them,
and what clay vessels amount to before a stone when they are struck against it.
I am saying these things against you, unclean spirit.
For what are you, a serpent, together with all your sins, before the power of God within the person who does what is good?
Do not boast over sleeping people because you have stripped them or plundered their houses.
Come out against those who are awake and watchful, O murderer!
Why do you go back and forth around them in the apparitions of dreams of many kinds?

If you want to fight, do not set up another device in which you wage war against the person who truly trusts in God and is free of your defilements, ready to fight you, you apostate from whom effeminacy originated and who rages after defilements of every kind.
You are the one through whom men and women fulfill their passions, those who have exchanged the activity natural to them for what is contrary to their nature.
You do not become a man, nor do you become a woman. You do not become a calf, a horse, a donkey, a camel, or any other animal.
Nor do you become a snake, a scorpion, or any other crawling creature.
You are not a barbarian, nor a gathering of evil people.
You are not a sea, nor a gathering of water.
You are not a well, nor a place that has been dug out.
You are not a mountain, nor land. You are not a rich man, nor a beggar.
For you take on the appearance of these and of many more things than these, yet you are not counted as one of them. Your form is still your own form.
And you are still yourself: the whole mass that writhes over its other parts or out from its other parts.
And you have not even a small portion of a limb in anything—you and your other demons.
For every form into which you change yourself is foreign to you.
They are all apparitions.
What do you have to do with heaven, the air, and the light, that you should assume their appearance?

Likewise, you portray what will happen at the end with fire, an earthquake, a great flame, and smoke rushing across the earth, as though the whole inhabited world were going to be destroyed by the false darkness spreading over the entire world. Together with your demons, you also assume the appearance of crowds of people, running and shouting, 'It is the end!' You cause confusion, falling, getting up, and striking the ground—all this so that you may deceive those who see your ungodly apparitions in dreams.

This is how you have often proclaimed since the beginning of time, among those who belong to you, 'It is the end!' when it is not. They lie through you, and you lie through them, while they think that the one through whom they see is an angel of light.
Or why are you concerned about a person, that you should counsel him, “Do not sin,” when instead you want to kill him? All your deceit, and all the death of error!
You act as a king, a soldier, or a ruler, intending to assume their appearance so that you may terrify those who will terrify you.
What business do you have portraying Hades, as though you were binding people and throwing them down into the fire, while clothing yourself in your false adornment of light as God and Christ?
Everything distorted, everything that will never happen—these are what you possess.
For the forms in which you enter among those who belong to you while they are awake...
Those whose hearts are set on Jesus are not the ones you visit in dreams.
For if you do not appear to those who belong to you as an angel, they will not believe you.
For they do not know what an angel of the Lord looks like.
It is in the form of a demon that they know you.
But if you appear in your own forms to those who are on guard against you while they are awake, you know that they will recognize you.
What will you do?
You assume the form of an angel of light before them.
Yet again they catch you in this, and you cannot hide from them.
For even if they act as though they want to raise their hands against you, [?] like someone who has fallen among them.

For those whom God's providence never leaves recognize the true angel, and every true dream and every true deed, and every true word and every true form, among all those things by which you tempt people.
For testing is followed by a good hope for those who test the spirits of truth and the spirits of deception.
Otherwise, the vessel that is mad [?]
Why should we be foolish enough to wait for an angel or a spirit to appear to us outwardly or to speak with us, when God and his Spirit and his angels speak with us inwardly?
For it is the empty people, those in whom Jesus does not dwell, whom you ensnare through these forms.
You cannot truly laugh at those who belong to Christ.
For what is there in which you have not made godless people your slaves, so that they might be free of these other things?

Blessed are those who will see your destruction without being destroyed with you, on the day when the wrath of the one whose handiwork you destroyed will grind you down like a potsherd, throw you down, and scatter you in Hades.
Woe to those who will indeed see your destruction but perish with you!
Woe to those who have not recognized your manner of speaking or your deceit, because they have not recognized the voice of the Scriptures that has gone out over the whole earth!

Blessed are those who have recognized you and your hidden schemes, especially your defilements, which even little children can recognize and which are not hidden from those who examine you and your impurities: the crooked one who taught all those who walk in crookedness, the one who was rejected after causing many peoples to be rejected.
From where, then, will they say to the human race, “Call them rejected silver, because the Lord has rejected them”?

If I say that the leech was created so that you might be compared to it—this creature whose daughters have not been satisfied—indeed, you surpass it and exceed it, and it cannot match you in insatiability.
Three things have been named that are truly never satisfied by the desire that feeds them.

But you have not been satisfied by the bloodshedder, the idol worshiper, the pagan, the heretic, the oppressor, the sexually immoral person, the effeminate man, the unbeliever, or all those who have abandoned God, you murderer!
Blessed, then, are those who have never tasted your food, so that you might taste theirs, because those whose food you will taste must taste yours.
For the ways of eating that you share with them are the same.

Blessed also are those who have lodged in your throat, whom you could not swallow because of their large bones—that is, those with whom you are angry and whom you pursue, although you cannot overcome them because of their faith in God and their goodness.
Blessed also are those who made you spit them out against your will after you swallowed them.
And that decree of repeated rebuke will make you miserable until the end, when Jesus will wipe away even the remnants of your thoughts from the earth, and you will cease to exist.
The one who is never satisfied will swallow the one who is never satisfied.
I am speaking of Hades, into which you will descend.
You have never had your fill of killing people.
He will never have his fill of killing you. And would his insatiability not be greater than yours, surpassing it by far?
How you will be held in it forever and ever—you and those who fulfilled their desires with you, and you with them in unnatural acts!
The snake's venom is limited, and in this it has not gone beyond its nature.
For God is the one who put it inside it,
But you have produced your own wrath for yourself alone. And how can it have a limit, when it comes from you?
How far can the snake spray water?
For perhaps the waters will reach those near it.
For even if it leaps again or attacks, whom will it reach?
Or how many will it strike?
however abundant it may be.
But you, ungodly one, your venom reaches everyone in the whole inhabited world.
You spit and spray at everyone in the whole world,
from the beginning until today.
And it is a wonder that those great, abundant waters come out of your mouth, while you do not hold back from blowing them out with all your strength.
Many are those who guard against them everywhere so that they do not reach them.
And if some droplets of them have reached many people, Christ's coming cleanses them of these until the end.
The snake spits water into the eyes of the body, but you throw it into the eyes of the heart.
Thus those whom you have made permanently blind are miserable and wretched.
For just as your tyranny is great over those who have fallen beneath you, whom you have trampled, so too your weakness before those beneath whom you fall, who trample you, cannot be described.
You have no other power or anything else to do to them in your ungodliness, except to rage against the outside of their bodies with diseases that vary in many ways, as we have said.

For if you had been able to drag them and bring them down into your abominations, what would you have gained by fighting them with apparitions of many kinds, so that you do not let them sleep, while they see you utterly filthy, with every kind of filth around you, as you change into your abominations and your abominations change into you, so that they vomit while asleep or when they wake up?
For the snake has no other power besides its venom.
It has no hand or foot, no horn or hoof.
And people are not afraid of its teeth, but of its venom.
Otherwise, it is only a snake, like a piece of rope, dry and very weak, easy to destroy. And anyone who escapes its venom will not die because of it.
You yourself, all the more, enemy,
have no other power except the soldiers of your sins.

For you are maimed and diminished more than the snake. Not only has God made you poor in these things, but he has also crushed your bodily form, as it is written and as we recognize you through your weakness.

At least the snake's body remains intact until it is caught. For those who fear you and your apparitions at night, and also during the day—these are the things through which the person saying this knows you—
are afraid of a corpse.
And whoever exposes your godlessness does not care that you exist.
Even if you once had swords, you do not have them now. For it is impossible for Scripture to say something that is not true: “Your swords have utterly failed.”
And even if you still have some, they are not yours.
Rather, they belong to those who acted foolishly and gave them to you against themselves, because it is people who give you the power to overpower them.
I will tell everyone what you are and what has been done to you.

For you are like a soldier whose hands and feet the king cut off, and whose sword, weapons, and all his military equipment he took away. He banished him from his home and his city because he had opposed him. And because of his patience,
he left him alive until the day when he wishes to take his life from him.
This is what has been done to you.

This is how you were cut down and thrown out of heaven and out of its entire army of angels, because you dared, you fool and blind one, not realizing that clay cannot oppose the one who fashioned it into a despised vessel, and not an honored vessel, from that time onward.
Nor, even before you fell, did you ever stand in truth.
Nor did honor ever come to you.
For you have been accursed before God since he created you.
For he knows everything about your beginning and your end: it is all wickedness, malice, and envy.
You truly are a runaway, a worthless slave who fled from his master, although you cannot escape him or hide from him.
I know something that is not hidden from the wise. What is it?
Christ endured and bore with those who cursed [?] him through you, according to your wicked plan.
But because of your weakness, you do not know what to do before those who ask Jesus to destroy you from around his people and wipe you out.
But since it is clear that you are of this kind,

you no longer have armor, or a sword and axe, or a sapphire belt, or a long robe, or a javelin, or the appearance of lightning, or equipment. Nor have you had armor from that time onward like that of Raphael and Gabriel, and that of the great archangel Michael, and that of all the angels.
The things that belong to you and in which you abound—I will reveal them to everyone.
Instead of an angel's armor and a belt, you have put on a devil's armor, and you have girded yourself with a belt of falsehood.
Instead of a shining appearance and a garment that gives light, you have an appearance of darkness, and the garment you wear is one of darkness, gloom, and filth, you utter darkness!

Instead of an angel's sword and the power of the Holy Spirit, you have powerlessness, ruin, and every defilement. All your deeds arise from violence, adultery, pollution, jealousy, and your other acts of godlessness, which we do not need to name one by one.
For we have come to know them all, and we have understood that you and your sins are a mass of brushwood piled together for someone to throw fire onto it and warm himself by it.
It will become dark before him. But for anyone who is careless, it becomes an arrow, a sword, and every kind of weapon of war before him.
For you have struck every godless nation with all your lawless acts, and not with a spear or another javelin.
But the people who truly belong to God strike you with their purity and their righteousness, with every kind of good deed and every form of devotion to God.
You therefore truly reveal that you have no power at all.
Neither you nor your demons can make a person sin unless his will precedes your thought, and his desire comes before your counsel or follows it.
As for the trials through which you harm the bodies of those who resist your detestable thoughts, this is not your own doing.
Rather, it is due to God's forbearance.
Indeed, any power that works evil is no power at all, like the power within you and within your people.
Your people, or those who have become your people, are all those whom the Gospel has counted as chaff that will be burned in an unquenchable fire.
Look: if I were insulting an angel of God like this—may that never happen!
Rather, he is blessed all the more.
He would have burned me with his fiery flame, because he has power.
But you, Cronus, I insult.
And I say these things against you, and things worse than these, during the day—or rather, during the night—and every single day.
You have not found anything you can do to me.

For if you had power, and if it were not for Christ’s help, you would not delay. It is no victory for you that you have filled the body of the [?] with evil. If this is your power, whom do you overcome except those whom you have cast down into unnatural acts of every kind, knowingly and not in ignorance?
If this is your power, whom have you overcome apart from those whom you have struck down into every kind of unnatural behavior, knowingly and not in ignorance?
For everyone who has not yet known you and your magic has forgiveness before the Lord.

Or are you a judge, you master of deceit? Sometimes you persuade those whom you lead into sin that God will not call them to account; sometimes you trouble the hearts of those who want to escape your evils by saying that God will not forgive them.
As if you knew the mind of the Most High and the compassion expressed in the words of this declaration:
“Let the ungodly person abandon his ways, and the lawless person his plans.
Let him return to the Lord, and he will have mercy on him, for he will abundantly forgive your sins.
For my plans were not like your plans, and my ways were not like your ways.
Rather, just as heaven is far from the earth, so my way is far from your way, and your thoughts from my thought.”
You have no power there, demon, except to destroy.
It is blasphemy to say that you can heal or do anything good, as the Greeks suppose, until you hand them over to the flame of God’s wrath.
Those whose custom it is to fight against you say this because you torment their bodies with afflictions:
“Keep away from the bodies of Christ and his members, for they will submit to him and serve him, and receive grace from him while they suffer other illnesses.”
This shows that you have gained nothing, or that you will gain nothing from a person who fears God.
The righteous Job became rich in God [?] not only because of his acts of mercy, but also because of his illnesses.
Lazarus not only had nothing to give, but even longed to be filled with what fell from that rich man’s table.
And we see no other deed for which he was placed in the bosom of the great patriarch, except that he endured illnesses.
Letter of Shenoute.
